Cliff Drive is an MLS® area name in Tsawwassen, in the City of Delta. Cliff Drive Elementary is at 5025 12 Avenue, and 12 Avenue meets 56 Street at the core of the City’s planned Tsawwassen Urban Centre. Listings in this area have included addresses on 12 Avenue, 18 Avenue, 55A Street and 56 Street. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it. See all

Planning and zoning

blocks.text: Planning around Cliff Drive and the Tsawwassen core

parts.t: Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
Delta Council adopted the Official Community Plan 2024 (Bylaw No. 8400) on July 8, 2024.
City news release

For Tsawwassen, the OCP puts the focus for growth in and around the Tsawwassen Urban Centre and along the 56 Street corridor, plus Southlands and the final phase of Tsawwassen Springs. Its projections suggest about 11,600 new residents in 4,800 new homes by 2051.
City OCP 2024

The OCP describes the Tsawwassen Urban Centre as a walkable community with low and mid-rise buildings on the periphery and higher forms towards the core around 56th Street and 12th Avenue, with shops along ground-level high streets. A development permit area sets form and character rules for commercial, multi-unit and mixed-use buildings there.
City OCP 2024
On the City’s Tsawwassen page, the community has a central shopping corridor with local boutiques.
City of Delta page

Delta changed its zoning in 2024 so that a lot zoned for a single detached home or a duplex can have up to three units (on lots up to 280 m²) or four units (on larger lots), including a secondary suite and up to two garden suites or coach houses, without rezoning. Each unit needs one parking space on the lot, and covenants, steep slopes and nearby streams can limit what is possible. Ask me or the City about an address.
City of Delta SSMUH page

The City’s development considerations page says to use DeltaMap to confirm whether a property sits in a development permit area, and to check the title for charges such as statutory rights-of-way, easements and covenants that can limit how a property is used.

Where is Cliff Drive?

Cliff Drive is an MLS® area name in Tsawwassen. Cliff Drive Elementary is at 5025 12 Avenue, and listings in this area have included addresses on 12 Avenue, 18 Avenue, 55A Street and 56 Street. These edges are approximate and are not an official City boundary, so ask me if a specific address is in it.
Is the Cliff Drive MLS® area the same as the school catchment?

No. The MLS® area is set by the real estate board and the school catchment is set by Delta School District, so the two lines do not match. The district’s 2017 elementary map shows the Cliff Drive catchment covering a large part of central Tsawwassen.
District map (PDF)
Check an address with the
school locator
Which schools serve Cliff Drive?

Cliff Drive Elementary (kindergarten to grade 7) is at 5025 12 Avenue and offers Late French Immersion in Grades 6 and 7. Early French Immersion for the Cliff Drive catchment is at South Park Elementary, 735 Gilchrist Drive. South Delta Secondary (grades 8 to 12) is at 750 53 Street. Check the exact address with the
school locator
What does the City plan near 56 Street and 12 Avenue?

The OCP 2024 plans the Tsawwassen Urban Centre around that corner, with higher buildings towards the core and low and mid-rise buildings on the edges. It also names the 56 Street corridor as a growth focus.
City OCP 2024

What is happening with the Winskill pool and 56 Street?

The City started building a new Winskill Aquatic and Fitness Centre in summer 2025. It will have a ten-lane, 25-metre lap pool, a leisure pool and a new gymnasium. A temporary construction traffic light is on 56 Street between 9 and 10 Avenue. See the
City project page
for current notices.
Can I add a suite to a Cliff Drive house?

Possibly. A lot zoned for a single detached home or duplex can have a secondary suite and up to two garden suites or coach houses, within a cap of three units (lots up to 280 m²) or four units (larger lots). Each unit needs a parking space on the lot, and covenants or slopes can limit it. Send me the address and I’ll check.
